channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Fidan will attend Ukraine peace talks in Paris
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan will attend a high-level meeting in Paris on Jan. 6 with leaders from Ukraine, France and other prominent European powers amid ongoing efforts to seal an agreement between Moscow and Kiev to end the 4-year-old war, Turkish diplomatic sources have informed.

item.title: Nahita: Looking at Anatolia from ‘A Good Place’
item.description: Nahita stands out for its restrained menu and commitment to locality, sustainability and culinary responsibility in Cappadocia.

item.title: Study reveals Anatolian shepherd dogs sent from Erzurum to US
item.description: Research has revealed that Anatolian shepherd dogs selected from the high plateaus of Erzurum were sent to the United States in 1938 with the approval of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, in a process that went beyond a simple animal transfer and carried diplomatic, scientific and military dimensions.

item.title: Health Museum in Edirne hosts nearly 160,000 visitors in 2025
item.description: The Health Museum at Edirne’s Sultan Bayezid II Complex welcomed nearly 160,000 visitors last year, drawing tourists from dozens of countries and showcasing the advanced medical practices of the Ottoman era

item.title: Turkish industry achieves record $195 billion in exports in 2025
item.description: Türkiye’s industrial sector posted its highest annual export performance ever in 2025, reaching $194.8 billion, up 6 percent from 2024, according to data from the Türkiye Exporters Assembly (TİM).

item.title: Damascus, SDF agree to hold further talks on integration deal
item.description: Syrian authorities in Damascus and the YPG-held Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on Jan. 4 agreed to hold more meetings after a meeting on integrating the SDF’s forces into the central government.

item.title: Türkiye’s annual inflation rate drops to 30.89 percent in December
item.description: Türkiye's annual inflation rate dropped to 30.89 percent in December, down from 31.07 percent in November, official figures showed on Jan. 5.

item.title: US plan to seize Venezuela's oil industry faces major hurdles
item.description: President Donald Trump's plan to take control of Venezuela's oil industry and ask American companies to revitalize it after capturing President Nicolás Maduro in a raid isn't likely to have a significant immediate impact on oil prices.

item.title: Erdoğan: Türkiye's return to F-35 program key to NATO security
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan has called for Türkiye’s reentry into the U.S.-led F-35 fighter jet program, framing the move as a vital step to cement ties with Washington and bolster NATO security.

item.title: Trump declares US 'in charge' of Venezuela
item.description: President Donald Trump has insisted the United States is "in charge" of Venezuela after the seizure of Nicolas Maduro, but is also dealing with the new leadership in Caracas.
